user_story: As a staff member, I want to confirm a booking so that the guest knows their reservation is secured.

positive.title: Confirm a standard booking successfully
steps: Log in as a staff member
Navigate to the bookings management page
Select a pending booking from the list
positive.expected_result: The booking is confirmed, and a confirmation message 'Booking successfully confirmed' is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to confirm a booking without being logged in
steps: Navigate to the bookings management page without logging in
negative.expected_result: Access is denied, and the user is prompted with a login page.

edge.title: Confirm a booking for a past date
steps: Log in as a staff member
Navigate to the bookings management page
Select a pending booking with a past date
edge.expected_result: The system displays an error message 'Cannot confirm a booking for a past date'.
